record.title: Prepare documented physical option-status queries
record.intent: Freeze the smallest supported read-only option baseline before native observation.
requirements: Preserve official guide provenance and exact eleven documented option selectors. Use one identity query and one status query per selector; no mutations or unsupported aliases.
Prepare fresh baseline, full capture, existing single-client isolated lease maintenance, source-bound SCPI connection and bounded raw response retention.
Reidentify the scope-facing hardware, verify isolation before contact and preserve exact restoration state. Stop on unexpected traffic, identity, reply, recorder failure or drops.
No ADB, helper staging, Web Control, USB, reboot, option installation or capability transition in this batch.
Validate request sequencing using a host-only socket control. Commit and push preparation before physical contact.
acceptance: A frozen read-only query sequence and observation controls are prepared.
